subject: Action: Fiscal representative, e-invoice format and PO remit flow for Seaborn BV
messages:
From: Sanae Ishikawa <sanae@seaborn-bv.nl>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: vendor-ops@seaborn-bv.nl
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Seaborn e-invoice requirements & PO setup info

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. To proceed with Redwood procurement we need confirmation on two items so our finance team can match incoming POs to our e-invoices: 

1) Which Redwood legal entity will issue the PO (legal name + VAT/Tax ID) so we can set remit-to and VAT handling on our side.
2) Is Redwood able to accept Peppol/UBL e-invoices (XML) or do you require PDF attachments only? If XML is preferred, we can provide a sample.

Attached: Seaborn-einvoice-spec.pdf (1 page) — shows our XML element names and the fiscal-representative block.

Also, please confirm whether Redwood requires a Dutch fiscal representative letter for withholding/VAT-proof purposes; our ERP can include the fiscal rep block in the XML automatically if you accept it.

Sanae Ishikawa
Head of Finance Ops | Seaborn Logistics BV
vendor-ops@seaborn-bv.nl
+31 20 555 0198

[attachment: Seaborn-einvoice-spec.pdf (PDF, 1 page)]

From: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
To: Sanae Ishikawa <sanae@seaborn-bv.nl>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Seaborn e-invoice requirements & PO setup info

Hi Sanae — thanks, this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from the procurement side so we can finalize the vendor record and PO mapping:

- Redwood PO issuer: we normally route POs from one of two entities for EU vendors — "Redwood Inference Europe B.V." (NL) or "Redwood EU Operations GmbH" (DE). For logistics vendors we prefer the NL entity where possible. Can you confirm whether the remit-to on your invoices should point to Seaborn BV (same as vendor) or to your fiscal representative?

- e-invoice format: we can accept Peppol/UBL XML. If you can include a sample XML that includes the fiscal rep element and VATIDs it will speed validation.

- Evidence: to accept VAT reverse charge and route PO to the NL legal entity, our tax team requires either: 
  * the vendor's EU VAT registration (BTW/VAT number) AND a company extract showing the registered address, or
  * a fiscal representative letter (signed) if the vendor uses a fiscal rep to handle VAT in the Netherlands.

Laura — tagging you for procurement checks (PO template & banking verification).
Karthik — can you confirm the minimal fiscal-rep artefacts we accept (signed PDF, notarised doc, or certified letter)?

Next step: Sanae, if you can send the sample XML and the fiscal rep letter (if available) we'll run it through our AP validation.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sanae Ishikawa <sanae@seaborn-bv.nl>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com
Cc: vendor-ops@seaborn-bv.nl
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:17:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Seaborn e-invoice requirements & PO setup info

Jonas — thanks, attached are the two requested artefacts.

1) Seaborn-fiscal-rep-letter.pdf — signed letter from our Dutch fiscal representative (Van Dijk Fiscal Services) confirming representation for VAT handling.
2) INV-20270228-example.xml — example Peppol/UBL xml export showing our fiscalRepParty block and VATIDs.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Remit-to on invoice: please set remit-to to Seaborn Logistics BV (our primary bank account). Fiscal rep is for VAT handling only; payment should go to Seaborn BV.
- We can include item-level VAT rates and the VAT IDs in the XML as you request.

Let us know if Redwood wants the fiscal rep letter notarised; our rep has both signed and certified copies.

Regards,
Sanae

[attachments: Seaborn-fiscal-rep-letter.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), INV-20270228-example.xml (XML sample)]

From: laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
To: Sanae Ishikawa <sanae@seaborn-bv.nl>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Seaborn e-invoice requirements & PO setup info — PO fields and onboarding docs

Hi Sanae — welcome, and thanks for the files. I started the vendor record draft in our vendor portal and have a couple of operational asks so AP can automatically match: 

Please provide the following by end of week so we can generate the first PO and enable e-invoice matching:
- Company extract (Chamber of Commerce extract or equivalent) showing registered name and address.
- Bank account verification (bank statement stub or voided deposit slip) for the Seaborn BV account you want payment routed to.
- Confirmation of address that should appear on the PO (billing vs shipping).
- Preferred PO reference field: Order number vs Redwood Project code.

I attached our standard PO template (PO-template-Seaborn.xlsx) — please confirm which billing entity to populate. We will default to issuing PO from "Redwood Inference Europe B.V." unless you ask otherwise.

Note on fiscal rep: our tax team (cc'd) accepts the signed fiscal rep letter you provided; notarisation not required for initial validation but we may ask for certified copy for the ledger.

Next steps: once we have the company extract + bank stub we will: 
1) finalize vendor record;
2) send a DocuSign for our standard supplier forms (W-8/EU tax attestation variations not applicable for EU vendors);
3) issue a test PO (small value) for invoice XML validation.

Thanks — Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodai.com
[attachment: PO-template-Seaborn.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
To: Sanae Ishikawa <sanae@seaborn-bv.nl>, laura_bennett@redwoodai.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwoodai.com, ben_carter@redwoodai.com
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 10:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Seaborn e-invoice requirements & PO setup — tax acceptance and routing

Hi Sanae — quick tax confirmation from our side. Thanks for the fiscal rep letter and the sample XML — that covers the majority of our checks. Few points to close: 

• Accepted evidence: signed fiscal rep letter (PDF) OR EU VAT number + company extract (we already have the fiscal rep letter, good).
• VAT treatment: Redwood will accept invoice with VAT fields present; for services where reverse charge applies we will not remit VAT, but we require the invoice to include the vendor VAT ID and the fiscal rep block so our AP system can apply reverse-charge logic.
• PO routing: procure will issue PO from Redwood Inference Europe B.V. (NL). Payment will flow to the Seaborn BV bank account you specify in the bank-stub.
• XML validation: please ensure the UBL Invoice element includes: SellerCustomerParty/Party/PartyIdentification (VAT ID), AccountingSupplierParty with fiscalRepParty block, and InvoiceLine VAT details. Our validation team will run one test PO through Peppol gateway.

If you can return the company extract and the bank stub we will enable the vendor and plan the validation PO for next week. Once test passes we will flip the e-invoice matching to production.

One small ask for DocuSign: please ensure the fiscal rep letter is signed by the rep and the signature is visible in the PDF (we had an unsigned scan previously that caused a delay).

Thanks — Karthik Iyer
Tax & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
